The accuracy is used as a performance evaluator and gives weightage to sentiments given in the form of emojis. A multimodal classification model is utilized here by considering both text and emojis for the final output. The comparati ve study is also done on the word embedding methods of the Word2Vec model. According to the findings of the experiments, the proposed system outperforms the sentiment analysis models, which considers only text for evaluation.

articleTitle: Real Time Crop Prediction based on Soil Analysis using Internet of Things and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Research in the realm of the agriculture sector is expanding. More than half of India's population depends on agriculture for livelihood, and it is a major contributor to the country's economic growth. Soil quality is changing drastically, affecting the agricultural crop yield. Machine learning and deep learning algorithms are effectively helping to predict the crop based on the soil quality of the land. Data on temperature, humidity, rainfall, soil moisture, and pH are needed to train the machine-learning models. This work has been carried out using the following machine learning models: Decision Tree classifier, K-Neighbor classifier, and Random Forest classifier models. The accuracy of the Random Forest classifier is 93.11 percent, which is higher than the accuracy of the Decision Tree classifier (90.96 percent) and the accuracy of the K-Neighbors classifier (87.63 percent). Along with accuracy, the following performance metrics, such as precision, F1 score, recall, mean absolute error, and log loss, are taken into account. Web-based software has been developed to forecast the crop prediction of farmland based on soil conditions. The real-time data on the soil quality is gathered using the IoT devices from the farm, and the data is saved in the cloud. The data is fed to the machine learning model to predict the crop that would be most suited for cultivation on the farm. Since this is a real-time strategy, farmers can predict the crop with greater accuracy, resulting in higher yields.

articleTitle: Support Vector Machine Classifier based Lung Cancer Recognition: A Fusion Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: The emergence of computer-aided detection systems emphasized the need of clinical analysis in making decisions regarding human diseases. The evaluation procedure requires special attention since majority of the population have been affected by it resulting in a higher fatality rate. Traditional lung cancer prediction algorithms failed to manage accuracy due to data balance issues and low-quality images that interfere with discriminate features. In this paper, new feature fusion approach used by combining both EfficientNetB7 deep feature and statistical features and ADASYN applied to overcome the problem of data imbalance problem in the dataset. Balance feature set is classified using SVM classifier. Experiments conducted on the IQ-OTHNCCD lung cancer dataset demonstrate that our proposed methods are able to achieve better performance compared with the state of the art. The experimental study showed that the proposed model is efficient in terms of f-measure.

articleTitle: Auto - Moving Wheelchair with Obstacle Detection and Health Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: People suffering from severe infirmities mostly rely on power wheelchairs to move around. It becomes more important to monitor our loved ones for their health and safety especially when they grow old. Due to the weak joints, aged people have difficulties in walking and there is a great risk of falling. For a person who is weak, moving in a power wheelchair can be risky, for both the person and the surrounding environment. So, an Auto moving wheelchair with fall detection and health monitoring system has been introduced in this paper. This reduces the effort to move the wheels for the wheelchair, by using a mobile application. In addition, it also provides a possibility for those who are physically or visually disabled to move from one location to other. Furthermore, the wheelchair has an obstacle recognition system that lowers the possibility of a collision while in motion. Moreover, it has a fall detection system that monitors the patient's mobility with an accelerometer sensor and notifies anyone in the immediate area if a fall is detected. This product is very helpful when travelling with elders from one location to another, and can be utilised in nursing homes as well.

articleTitle: Non-Uniform Filter Bank Visualization based Prediction Models for Respiratory Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Chronic respiratory disorders (CRDs) and lower res piratory illness are the common widespread infection emphasized by obstruction of flow of air in alveoli. Listening to breathe sounds of the respiratory system is a traditional technique used for diagnosing chronic disorders in patients. However, the outcomes of diagnosis can be sensed only by skilled therapist which imposes limitations on quantifiable results. This urged to the development of technology driven tools for detecting the disorders. Most of the earlier studies focused on analyzing the breathe sounds using different filter banks (FBs) such as Discrete cosine transform (DCT) FBs, Wavelet FBs, Mel FBs and s pectrograms for classification using CNN deep learning models. Owing to the nature of exactly matching the frequency characteristics of FBs with that of human ears, Octave FBs and Cross over FBs are proposed in this work. The filter coefficients extracted using proposed FBs are transformed into s pectrogram time Frequency Visualization and are classified using three Transfer learning (TL) viz. GoogLeNet, S queezeNet and ResNet-50. The comparative results with existing method reveal that the proposed FB produces significant improvement in accuracy of 90.63% and 90.89% for ResNet-50 classifier.

articleTitle: Li-Fi Technology for Vehicle-to-Vehicle Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: In Smart Cities, vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication has been found to be the best way to cut down on traffic accidents. A lot of different wireless communication methods are used by the Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) to exchange data (ITS). Because there will be a lot of cars on the road, there will be a lot of accidents. Li-Fi (Light-Fidelity), which uses light-fidelity technology to send and receive data quickly and reliably between cars, is becoming more and more popular. Using Li-Fi in-vehicle communications could be a cheap way to communicate that has a high data rate and a lot of bandwidth efficiency.

articleTitle: Development of Data Center based on Cloud Computing Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: The author firstly builds the energy green scheduling model of cloud computing data center, then trains the model in deep neural network based on artificial intelligence technology, and finally designs a distributed energy management method from the perspective of cost minimization and carbon emission minimization. According to the design of the scheme, some key technologies are used to compare and implement the relevant modules in the laboratory environment, and the security of the data center can be controlled through an intuitive interface, thus ensuring the security of the data center. Computational resources, storage Design resources, network resources and their virtualization, put forward a cross-campus master and backup data center system implementation plan, and briefly analyze potential problems and drawbacks

articleTitle: Blockchain based Electronic Voting Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Technology is extremely important in everyday life. With the rising use of technology, new invention and breakthroughs have brought about a significant transformation in democracy. Elections influence a country’s future. Even the world’s most powerful democracies are burdened by a defective voting system. The biggest flaws in the existing voting system include election rigging, hacking, manipulation, and polling booth capture. Blockchain is a new, decentralized, and distributed technology that focuses on high security. Implementing voting through blockchain might remove current voting system issues. Blockchain is a strong tool because of its smart contracts and several features that outperform older systems. Smart contracts are significant bits of code that must be inserted into blockchain and implemented according to the plan in all phases of the blockchain update process. Online voting has become a talk and subject in the world of internet services. The blockchain appears to be a promising option for application in the construction of safer, more secure voting system. A voting application system has been created as a smart transaction in this project to examine the use of blockchain to construct distributed electronic voting systems.

articleTitle: Prediction of Brain Stroke using Machine Learning with Relief Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Stroke is one of the leading factors of fatality in people today. Numerous conditions, including stress, high blood pressure, cholesterol, obesity, type 2 diabetes, and dyslipidemia illnesses, may all contribute to stroke. By measuring the recorded values of the patients for about 31 features, such as heart rate, cholesterol level, blood pressure, heart rate, diabetes, metabolic syndrome, haemoglobin, steatosis, fibrosis, hepatocellular carcinoma, Body Mass Index (BMI) and so on. The proposed system uses machine learning to predict strokes in patients. The patient data is used to anticipate their health conditions and so as to save their lives. To anticipate strokes, comparing machine learning techniques K-Nearest Neighbour(KNN), Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Logistic Regression (LR) are used. The relief algorithm is used to select the necessary attributes. An ensemble model comprising SVM, RF, and KNN gives better accuracy compared to base models.

articleTitle: Federated Learning Approach for Tracking Malicious Activities in Cyber-Physical Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: The fast rise of the Internet and advanced technologies causes an increase in network traffic, making network infrastructure increasingly complicated and varied. Mobile phones, wearable gadgets, and driverless cars are all instances of dispersed networks that create massive amounts of data every day. The processing capability of these devices has also increased steadily, necessitating the need to transport data, store data locally, and direct network calculations to edge devices. Intrusion detection systems are essential in guaranteeing the safety and confidentiality of such equipment. Deep Learning (DL) combined Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) have gained prominence due to their excellent categorization accuracy. However, the requirement to store and communicate data to a centralized server may jeopardize privacy and security concerns. Federated learning (FL), on the other hand, fits in nicely as private information decentralized learning approach that does not transport data but instead trains algorithms locally and sends the parameters to a centralized server. This work targets to offer an extensive overview of the FL in intrusion detection systems.

articleTitle: Data Interface Matching and Information Security Measurement of Scientific and Technological Innovation Measurement Analysis and Multi-Agent Economic MIS
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: This paper establishes a vector autoregressive model based on the current development status of the digital economy and studies the correlation between the digital economy and economic growth MIS from a dynamic perspective, and found that the digital economy has a strong supporting role in the growth of the total economic volume. The coordination degree model calculates the scientific and technological innovation capabilities of China's 30 provinces (except Tibet) from 2018 to 2022, and the coordination, green, open, and shared level of high-quality economic development. The basic principles of the composition of the security measurement are expounded, and the measurement information model can be used as a logic model. The analysis of security measure composition summarizes the selection principle and selection process of security measurement, and analyzes and compares the measure composition methods in several typical security measurement methods.

articleTitle: Abstractive Summarizer using Bi-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Abstractive Summarization (AS) of texts is the task of abstracting crucial information from the source. This paper presents an approach for text summarization in abstractive form with deep learning techniques. This paper develops a model that produces more precise and coherent summaries without redundancy problems. An efficient summarizer should provide the context from the input text in a brief manner. Thus, the output of the summarizer is abstracted information and is presented as a summary to the user. The dataset CNN Daily Mail is often used for multi -sentence summarizing techniques, and the AS models are usually used under an immense deep learning technique termed as seq-to-seq model. In the summarization part, the encoder-decoder model is typically applied. The most often used metric for evaluating the quality of summarization is identified: Recall - Oriented Understudy for Gisting Evaluation (ROUGE). The proposed summarizer performs better in terms of ROUGE.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Prediction using Standard Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Lots of women are suffering from Breast Cancer all over the world. Various data set about breast cancer is available online. Machine Learning algorithms are very useful in predicting breast cancer. In this paper six standard machine learning algorithms are applied on a data set for breast cancer prediction. These algorithms are giving better results while applied diferent data sets for different diseases. After testing these algorithms, it is observed that Logistic Regression is best with 98.5% accuracy for breast cancer prediction.

articleTitle: Analysis of Virtual Reality and Augmented Reality SDK’s and Game Engines: A Comparison
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: At present, many immersive technologies such as Augmented Reality (AR), Virtual Reality (VR), Mixed Reality (MR) and Extended Reality (XR) technologies are in demand because people tend to learn more through picturing the things rather than learning the things theoretically. Theoretical learning leads to boredom in Education. Therefore, with the aim of providing knowledge to the peers, this paper provides the discussion on the main foundation of the immersive technologies which are Game Engines and Software Development Kits (SDK’s). Many people assume Game engine and SDK to be same that is why this paper brings out more clarity about the difference between the two.

articleTitle: Application and Advancement of Sensor Technology in Bioelectronics Nano Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: The ability of sensors, the foundational technology of nano engineering , to not only endure the rigorous testing of the external environment but also to gather information accurately and promptly, is a critical assurance for the swift development of nanoelectronics .There are now 15 different types of sensors developed in India , including those with force, colour, biological, and voltage sensitivity. More and more sectors are using these sensors. This study, which is based on the current use of sensors, scientifically points out the development direction of sensor technology by examining the issues that arise in actual operation in order to expedite the development of high quality in the field of Bioelectronics

articleTitle: Energy Enhancement and Optimization of WSN using Firefly Algorithm and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is the interconnection of sensor nodes connected by wireless media on a network. All WSNs are under threat due to their short lifetime, reduced energy, decay, security issues, and more. The two main concerns in WSNs i.e., lifetime and energy, are due to multi-hop communication in WSN. To resolve this problem, this paper presents cluster based efficient data transmission using Firefly Optimization Algorithm (FOA) and Deep Learning based Multilayer Radial Neural Network (MRNN) algorithm. The proposed FOA algorithm is based on selecting the appropriate Cluster Head (CH) from sensor nodes. The purpose of selecting the correct CH is to decrease the energy consumption rate. Then, the proposed MRNN method employs the optimal path selection based on node weight, speed, and efficiency of data transfer performance. This paper highlights the optimal use of the proposed method to minimize the energy consumption of WSNs. In addition, the FOA-MRNN algorithm consumes significantly minimum energy, improves energy efficiency, and has less end-to-end latency performance results than those of the traditional methods.

articleTitle: Human Activity Recognition using Smartphone Dataset: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Cell Phones are becoming more refined with each new model release. These days phones ordinarily consolidate numerous sensors for various functions such as GPS tracking, temperature sensors, accelerometer, gyroscope, high-determination cameras. In recent years, Human Activity Recognition (HAR) has enabled various applications. The information gathered by HAR may be utilized for a number of reasons, including fitness tracking, health and safety, and entertainment, among others. An abundance of research has been conducted on real-time processing, which has resulted in increased power consumption of mobile devices. It is preferable that the activity identification process be as precise as possible, because of the resource limited feature of a mobile device. So, the research is to use the dataset from the smartphone and use various classification models to find out which classifier is more accurate and provides faster results.

articleTitle: Wearable Technology for the Improvement of HSE Management
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Analyzing HSE data is becoming essential to reduce injuries and fatalities in Oil and Gas industry. Huge amount of resources is being spent annually on researching and developing procedures to eliminate the catastrophic situations in HSE. To achieve an effective HSE management, there is a need to have smart decision-making technique or a platform that is based on agile and automated data collection. This research proposed an intelligent tracking of every personnel across the various work zones to improves the current practices of the HSE management systems. That improvement comes as the result of detecting workplace hazards at early stages which would provide the workplace with a safer environment. The developed platform bases its decisions on a public industry database of occupational injuries and illnesses. Those decisions are based on a set of parameters stored in those records. Our new mechanism improves the quality and quantity of data inserted into HSE management structures, thus avoiding occupational risks and leading to a harmless workstation.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Foreign Language Teaching by Information Platform Evaluation based on Intelligent Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: This paper analyzes the current situation of informatization construction in colleges and universities and the principles and applications of common data mining models, and focuses on the data mining of smart campus students' comprehensive evaluation system based on FP-growth algorithm, K-means clustering, true entropy, classification and regression models. , combined with the practice of smarter teaching, put forward the data model and system architecture of smarter classroom, expounded the educational big data research methodology of "four modeling and three analysis", and constructed the "overall chessboard" and 13 specific research questions for data mining and analysis of smarter classroom , which aims to provide solutions for the deep integration of data mining technology and smart campuses.

articleTitle: Identification of Nutrient Deficiency in Rice Leaves using DenseNet-121
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: India is renowned for rice farming. Rice as a most important crop has a huge bang on people's health since many cultivate it for a living, it provides jobs, and many small industries are dependent on its cultivation. There is a risk of significant losses due to various diseases and pets that can affect this planting. With the help of modern science and technology a number of research projects and methods are proposed to improve rice yields. In the plant nutrient system, leaf uniqueness varies according to potassium (K) phosphorus (P), and nitrogen (N) dietary pressures. Here we imported the dataset and performed data augmentation to enhance the mass of dataset and to obtain more accuracy. Then we applied DenseNet-121 which is one of the DenseNet group of models designed to perform image classification. It is then evaluated with Adam, RMSprop, Gradient descent optimizers which has given 95.40%, 98.49%, 93.50% of accuracy. This entire approach is done to identify the type of fertilizer that should be used in order to increase the yield of crop.

articleTitle: Noise Reduction and Enhancement Processing Method of Cement Concrete Pavement Image based on Frequency Domain Filtering and Small World Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: This paper improves the local adaptive contrast enhancement algorithm based on frequency domain filtering and small-world grids, and solves the problem of low crack recognition accuracy caused by uneven image brightness and low contrast. This paper improves the classic PM model. And combined with the translation invariant shear wave transform (SIST) theory to solve the problem of excessive random noise in the image, a series of filters to eliminate these spectral peaks are designed. According to the characteristics of the longitudinal striped interference belonging to the low frequency component, a filter is designed to suppress the low frequency and enhance the high frequency. The filter parameters are optimized to achieve the effect of eliminating this type of interference, and the effect is increased by 7.2%.

articleTitle: A Performance Improvement in Home Automation Through Uncontaminated Energy Interfaced with Multi Dimensional Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: The Management of devices often used in current homes is designed in terms of automation. This means that the energy and power required for the operation of that particular type of device will be calculated and supplied accordingly. It does not take place through human activities in any way. These operations, which take place entirely automatically, take up a lot of energy in some places. Thus there is not enough energy available to operate other devices. A machine learning method is proposed here to deal with this effectively. It records the nature of the machine and the energy and power required for it in advance in the database. It will provide the energy it needs based on those records. Then check the machine module again. If there is too much energy it will do it to another machine and so on. This reduces energy consumption by up to 70% and reduces power consumption by 62%. Furthermore, the results of the study clearly show that the energy utilization is 97% due to the use of this method.

articleTitle: Prediction of Crop Yield Production with Novel Lasso Regression against Polynomial Regression Algorithm to Achieve Higher Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: This article will improve the accuracy for prediction of crop yield using machine learning algorithms. The dataset used for this article consists of 1112 rows of data for the classification of crop yield. The data are labelled as "temperature", "humidity", "rainfall", "production", Which classifies the data or the crop yield data into these types, 20 number of dataset have been used for Lasso Regression (LR) taken as group-1 and is compared with Polynomial Regression (PR) algorithm taken as group-2 with 80% of G power. The dataset used for this study has various parameters with minimum confidence level of 95% and threshold of 0.05% The proposed system using novel Lasso Regression algorithm has achieved an improved accuracy of 94.20%, compared with PR algorithm with an accuracy of 75% with a significant value of two tailed tests is 0.001 with 95% confidence interval. This study found the prediction of crop yield using the LR is significantly better than the PR algorithm.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Machine Learning Algorithms for Voice based Gender Identification
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Gender classification is one of the major challenges in the domain of speech analysis now-a-days. Identification of gender from acoustic properties of voice such as mean, median, and frequency, is of high importance. Machine learning is used to solve this problem because it gives promising results for classification techniques. There are several algorithms that can be used to predict the gender using acoustic properties. In this work, classifiers are evaluated using 6 different machine learning algorithms. These algorithms include K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF), and Support Vector Machine (SVM), Support Vector Machine Using Poly kernel and Gradient Boosting (GB). For the same voice sample dataset, the accuracy, recall, precision and F1 Score are computed for all the above-mentioned classifiers. The accuracy obtained from KNN is 96.71, DT is 93.33%, Random Forest is 97.72%, SVM is 98.48%, SVM using Poly Kernel is 97.72%, Gradient Boosting is 96.96%. The predicted values of the considered evaluation metrices on test data for all above classifiers evidenced the supremacy of SVM classifier as it is best fitted model for gender identification of acoustic. SVM attained the accuracy of 98.48% which is the highest among all.

articleTitle: System Stability Modeling of Video Art Teaching Resource Sharing Platform Construction based on 5G Network Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: 5G network slicing technology will soon become one of the core technologies of mobile network education. Through the analysis of 5G network technology, the article predicts that art education will show more novel teaching scenarios under the support of new technology. It specifically studies the D2D communication technology in its key technologies, the needs and positioning of the video resource sharing platform system, and discusses the system structure, format and parameter setting, and digital conversion of video data. Construction method. Introduce its communication method, process, advantages, and resource allocation method, and briefly analyze its application in the train control system. Network film and television courseware is based on psychology, with film and television art as the carrier, and the teaching design model as the framework to establish a new teaching resource construction model.

articleTitle: Investigation of Kidney Stone Detection using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Image processing techniques have recently been popular in a variety of medical fields for image enhancement during the early phases of detection and treatment. Image processing-based kidney stone detection method is used to classify and report the presence of stone in kidney. Detecting a kidney stone in a human body is a difficult task; if incorrectly detected, it can lead to death, and some people with stone development in the kidney at the early stage do not see it as an infection, and it gradually harms the organ. There are various imaging methods to detect kidney diseases, they are: CT imaging, X-rays, and ultrasound imaging. MATLAB is used in this project to examine the kidney region and identify the kidney stone. Both image analysis and image quality enhancement depend on low-pre-processing approaches used during the improvement stage.

articleTitle: Development of AI Intelligent Decision-Making System for Engineering Project Investment Cost Control based on Big Data Information Collection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: The project investment intelligent control system has been discussed in this paper. In order to better illustrate the relevant arguments, an introduction to the overall intelligent construction project management system is given. Moreover, research on the big data information collection algorithm based on rough set model is explained. Since the traditional rough set model is not combined with the relational database system, many basic operations of the calculation of this model are carried out on the flat file. Combined with the actual situation of the highway, it emphasizes the use of cost analysis table method, construction period-cost synchronization analysis method, earning the research ideas of value analysis method and value engineering method for investment cost control. The test results show that the AI intelligent control engineering project investment cost decision-making system improves the efficiency by 6.63%.

articleTitle: Architectural and Functional Differences in Dot Net Solutions
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)

The sequential development of versions of .NET describes the importance and continuous feedback of customers about their experience. articleTitle: A Novel Algorithm for Detecting Spasmodic Dysphonia Voice Pathology using Random Forest Frame Work
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Spasmodic dysphonia, a rare voice disorder is detected in the current work using Random Forest frame work. Voice pathology is related to the vocal tract area affecting the quality of speech. Numerous voice pathologies have been over the years of them are unnoticed as the symptoms are not significant. Even the symptoms are known the nature of the disorder is difficult to identify due to the over lapping nature of the symptoms. The existing algorithms for voice pathology detection are capable of classifying between normal and affected subjects, while the nature of the disorder has been considered in the proposed algorithm. Computational complexity has been reduced due to the incorporation of finite significant energy features estimated over non overlapping frames. Classification of accuracy of 93.5 has been seen with a population of 100 trees.

articleTitle: Construction of an Application-Oriented Undergraduate College Student Integrity Education Information System based on Cluster Big Data Analysis Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Research Apache as an integrated resource management system. Apache Storm, Apache Spice and SARK RDD are used to process large-scale distributed real-time data streams, and Apache Kafka is used as message middleware to support asynchronous message communication. Taking Wuhan Business School as an example, it first briefly describes the significance of integrity education to the development of college students, and then analyzes the reasons for the lack of integrity in college students. people for reference. Operational ideas and countermeasures are put forward for the construction of new thinking of talent training in applied undergraduate colleges, the concept of conformity with local and regional economy, and the establishment of a three-dimensional professional evaluation system.

articleTitle: Software Implementation of Intelligent Models of Economic Indicators in the Era of 5G Network Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: This paper uses self-organizing data mining methods to analyze the dynamic changes of 5G networks and big data and its economic indicators in the economic indicator system, and then finds that in the economic indicator system, total wages are the most important for industrial economic growth. The PSP_HDP topic model improves the distribution process of model-topic and topic-economic indicators, thereby improving the distinction and recognition of economic topics, and can more effectively mine economic topics and economic element words related to the economy. JAVA has established the software design of the intelligent model of economic indicators.

articleTitle: An Effective Optimized Clustering Algorithm for Social Media
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: The increasing utilization of social media pose diverse challenges to the human society. A considerably larger number of users participate in social media discussions, wherein different users are assigned to different groups. The user will post both positive and negative comments while participating in the discussion. This research study proposes a novel method for categorizing different types of users and determining which category they belong to. Data mining methods may benefit the social media communications. After collecting the user conversations and network data from the social media traffic, the social media user relationships are investigated. The proposed method improves the clustering results while also introducing the concept of organising the user communications and network data from social media. This tool is used to determine how many people have seen and commented on a certain post. This assists in performing user classification. Once the user information such as user messages and network relationships has been collected, data mining techniques can be used to group different types of communities. On the other hand, the existing approaches struggle to capture the proper granularity of local stakeholders and their activity. This study provides a system for discovering different communities by grouping the messages from diverse networking data streams. To cluster data, the proposed system employs the K-Means clustering technique, Optimized Cluster Distance (OCD) method and genetic algorithm.

articleTitle: Realization of VR+AR in the Interactive Platform of Online Art Education in Colleges Under the Internet Ecological Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: VR is more and more widely used in various fields of life, and has achieved satisfactory results. This technology integrates computer and simulation technology, and has the characteristics of immersion, interaction and sharing, so its basic implementation is computer simulation of virtual environment. However, due to the relatively slow development of AR college art and design education in my country, so compared with cultural courses, there is still a big gap. In order to promote the development of art and design education in colleges and universities in my country, the exhibition platform of art works has been expanded and enriched. Widely disseminated on the Internet and self-media in digital form. Focus on the innovative development and application strategy of "Internet + art education".

articleTitle: Internet of Things based Smart Fencing System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Smart Fencing System is a system to protect farming lands and dwelling areas where trespassing of animals is a major issue. In this project a camera is placed where there is frequent wandering of animals and motion sensors (IR) are placed around the fence. In the proposed system images of different animals will be stored as a database. Image recognition is performed using OpenCV. When there is a detection of motion around the fence, the animal is encountered on camera and the image captured on camera is compared with that of the image in the database and if it matches, a buzzer is given, and a message is sent to the user’s mobile phone. A buzzer is made to ring which deters the animals from gaining access into the dwelling areas/agricultural fields. This project has a major advantage for humans and other living beings as buzzer is produced only when the wild animals that can harm the crops as well as humans tries to trespass the electric fence.

Author Keywords: MIT(Massachusetts Institute of Technology) app inventor.

articleTitle: A Hybrid E-Prescription Management System using IoT
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: With a development in generation and powerful cutting down of sensors, there are diverse tries to apply the brand-new generation in diverse regions to improve the first-class of human life. In the growing nations, the needy people discover the healthcare system to be expensive. As a result, this assignment is an undertaking to solve the healthcare issues currently faced by the society. To provide the powerful, clever, and dependable healthcare service to the patients, Internet of Things (IoT) ideas are used extensively to interconnect with clinical resources. The predominant goal of the assignment to sample a far-flung health tracking machine with the automated prescription. It is especially composed of three parts. The detection of patient’s vitals with the use of sensors is the primary element, sending the facts to the cloud garage being the second element and offering the detected facts for processing, far flung viewing, and prescribing the proper medicinal drug is the third element. Remote viewing of the facts permits the health practitioner to study a patient’s health development staying far from the health facility premises. Hence the proposed structure collects sensor facts via Arduino improvement board and ship them to the cloud, with the use of Node MCU in which it is far processed and analyzed for far flung viewing and medicinal drug suggestion. The medicinal drug prescription after studying facts might be proven at the web page dashboard.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Supervised Machine Learning Algorithm for Prediction of Diabetes
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Diabetes is affecting a lot of people nowadays. It is a very common disease throughout the world. People found it difficult to predict the probability of this disease at an earlier stage. The disease is not curable yet by medical science but it can only be controlled. Furthermore, patients of this disease have to take medicines throughout their life. This disease can be predicted using different statistical tools. This paper proposed a machine learning based model to predict this disease on the basis of medical symptoms of a patient. Three best known machine learning algorithms are applied to predict diabetes which are KNN, Logistic Regression and Random Forest. Models of these machine learning algorithms are implemented using python programming language. The prediction accuracy of these three machine learning models is calculated and compared. The out coming results shows that the Random Forest performs best among these three machine learning models.

articleTitle: Evaluation Framework for Human Bite Mark Image Acquisition-A Pioneer Study
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: A framework for a unified streamlined hierarchical evaluation approach of using Cone bean computed tomography (CBCT) imaging in human bite mark image acquisition is proposed. The framework development processis detailed, providing insights into the feasibility of the process. The framework has led to the development of the Model Evaluation Guidelines (MEG) for human bite mark image acquisition using CBCT, which identifies the vital features that need to be defined to designs a hierarchical evaluation frameworkas well as understand the inter-components relationships. This framework can be used as a first step towards a unified and reproducible evaluation process for forensic use of CBCT imaging, with important implications for the development of future guidelines in other extended forensic imaging methods, providing perception of end-users and their inclusivity in the guideline development process. This would leads towards positive acceptance and usability of the guidelines.

articleTitle: Prediction Software Design of Food Economy-Epidemic Situation based on Internet Financial Framework and Intelligent AI Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Combining the statistical analysis capabilities of the R language with the parallel storage and parallel computing architecture of Hadoop, and using technologies such as Logistics and Echarts, the epidemic big data support platform was designed and implemented. The weight is determined according to the optimal weighting theory, and the time series model, exponential smoothing model and GM(1, 1) forecasting model are combined. Based on the theory of CAS (CAS) modeling idea, the game model between various subjects under the condition of open economy is constructed, and the dynamic evolution simulation is carried out by using the Netlogo multi-agent platform.

articleTitle: Development of a Website for Malarial Detection using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Malaria is a bacterial disease which is commonly caused by mosquitoes. In India, approximately, 7500 people have died due to malaria. The screening methods for malaria include the analysis of blood samples. This research aims the development a website that is capable of predicting malaria by analyzing the images of blood cells. For this purpose, images of blood cells are collected as a dataset from Kaggle. Both healthy and blood cells infected with malaria are included in this dataset. Next, the dataset's photos are selected for training, testing, and validation. The picked pictures are then scaled down to a specific size. With the help of the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), a Deep Learning (DL) model is created. The preprocessed photos are then used to train this model. Model validation follows the training. The training and validation results are tallied and examined. Next, the model's accuracy and loss are evaluated. The highest accuracy of the model developed is 9% which was attained during the training. The model also produced the lowest loss value of 13% during the final epoch of the validation process. The model is then tested if the findings are satisfactory. The tested model is then deployed on a website. This website can be used as a pre-screening test for malaria in times when a person cannot reach out to the nearest doctor. This website can also be updated and converted as a software application in the future.

articleTitle: Hotspots and Policy Keyword Technology of Higher Vocational Education Reform based on Network Text Intelligent Analysis Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: The existing web page parsing technologies are analyzed and compared, and the method based on XQuery template is adopted to achieve accurate extraction of web page text metadata. 51 educational informatization policy documents are taken as the research object, and keyword research, word frequency research, text analysis and other methods have been used. 6 six keywords of China’s education informatization policy are put forward, and the picture of China’s education informatization policy is outlined. Introducing big data technology into education management practice and building an information-based education management model can better improve the level of education management in higher vocational colleges, play the role of education management as a guarantee, and cultivate students' professional quality.

articleTitle: Optimization in the Development of Online Real-Time Interactive Platform for University Guiding based on Isomorphic Concurrent Computer System Development
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: A co-design system of isomorphic mode with multi-domain characteristics is proposed, which is an online real-time interactive platform for university education based on isomorphic concurrent computer system. A new algorithm for isomorphism determination can be realized for any topology graph, and a software has been successfully developed to realize the automatic determination of topology. Finally, the development process of the software is given. The research adopts a communication mechanism based on "message", and the editing process of the 3D information model in the design is packaged as a "message" transmitted by the network.

articleTitle: Sports Life Differentiation Modeling Algorithm and Simulation Prediction based on Long-Acting Remote Heart Rate Sensor Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: The use of Arduino as the hardware development platform, by obtaining the sensor data wearing the patient, and performing pulse rate analysis by preprocessing the data, numerical filtering, predicting the career life of the golfrier. Studies have found that the international golf outstanding athletes have a long sports life, short period of professional yellow, and the number of famous agents, the highest ranking and the number of migrants and the age of the golden domain and the age of the transfer industry. For the domestic and international excellent men The age data contrast of golfers analyzes the gap between sports life and analyzes the various reasons thereof, and propose feasibility recommendations for the prolonging of sports life.

articleTitle: Data Sharing Algorithm of Fusion Information System of Party Building and Business Work in Private Colleges under Background of Data Collection Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Data sharing algorithm of the fusion information system of party building and business work in private colleges under the background of data collection mining is studied in this paper. In data sharing applications, it is very common to use data from multiple data providers for the fusion statistics and comprehensive decision-making. Data disseminators play the role of dissemination media, including collecting and discovering scientific datasets, realizing persistent storage and persistent access to datasets, statistics and analysis of data dissemination traces, and reporting on dissemination effects. With this theoretical basis, the designed model is focused on the fusion information system of party building and business work in private colleges under the background of data collection mining. The system is implemented and tested under different scenarios.

articleTitle: Analysis of SQL Database Code Optimization for Short Video Operation Mode based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: This article first proposes modeling based on the SQL database network structure, improving the short video operation mode, processing the short video text characteristics of the operator’s avatar, and using the deep neural network (DNN) in the video scoring stage. Algorithm for score prediction. By introducing the genetic crossover operation based on the probability model into this article, the problem of poor optimization effect in the later stage of the traditional crossover operation is effectively improved, and the algorithm convergence is accelerated; by introducing the genetic mutation operation based on the dynamic parameter control method into this article, the traditional mutation operation is improved In the later stage, the diversity of the population cannot be taken into account while maintaining good local search capabilities.

articleTitle: Application of Slow-Motion Images based on Visual Saliency Algorithm in Film and Television Advertising
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Based on the saliency calculation framework that integrates multiple features, a 3D visual saliency algorithm is proposed. The saliency results under each feature channel are calculated separately through the color information, motion information and depth information of the scene, and then the final saliency results are obtained through dynamic fusion. The slow-motion video real-time feedback method has a positive effect on cultivating students' cognitive thinking ability, stimulating students' interest in learning, improving self-learning ability and analysis ability, helping students to correct their actions in time, and improving teaching effects. The combination of real-life shooting and film and television special effects It has its own requirements for the processing of picture quality.

articleTitle: Computer-Aided Analysis Software of the Influence Mechanism of Students' Employment Pressure on Their Own Emotions based on Data Mining of Brain Signal Spectrum
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: In this paper, the spectral estimation theory and u pattern recognition theory are used to establish the Fuzzy pattern recognition system y of the EEG signal, and the EEG signal is automatically analyzed and diagnosed with the help of a computer. Employment stress and anxiety levels are significantly correlated, and employment stress and anxiety levels are significantly correlated. Anxiety level of high stress, high heart and resilience: low anxiety level, high melon power, low heart and resilience. articleTitle: Thyroid Tumor Diagnosis System using Spatial Fuzzy C-Means (SFCM) Classification Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: This methodology consists of preprocessing of ultra sound thyroid images, feature computations and diagnosis stage. The preprocessing stage of the proposed method detects and reduces the noise contents in the source ultra sound thyroid images. Then, the texture features are computed from the preprocessed ultra sound thyroid image. Finally, these features are diagnosed into normal, mild and severe case using spatial Fuzzy-C-Mean classification (SFCM) approach. This method is tested on the ultra sound thyroid images in both DDTI and Open-CAS dataset with respect to accuracy, precision, recall and diagnosis rate

articleTitle: High step-up DC-DC Converter based Renewable Energy System for Improving Power Quality and Low Voltage Stress using PI Controller Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: A solar cell turns photon energy into electrical potential in a P-N junction (P-Type and N-Type), which are both equivalent circuits. While synchronizing with various grid and non-linear loads, the PV Photovoltaic input source comprises oscillations distorting, voltage sags/swell, and dc voltage of power quality concerns. The proposed technique for resolving the problem is Grid-connected output-based Photovoltaic (P.V.) System Power Quality Improvement. Proportional Integral (PI) Controllers are used in this method to control parameters like sampling rate and Improved Disrupt and Observe values, which have a substantial impact on the inter oscillatory form property of PV systems. The High gain (Step-Up) DC-DC Converter coupled based capacitor is recovered by the passive clamped circuit, which also limits the switch. Maximum power point tracking is a controller technique that provides inter harmonic emission, which is one of the most significant pieces of enhancing source voltage and current. The end result is improved power quality and gain without even any distortion in the Renewable Energy System's output.

articleTitle: Construction of Teacher Competency Model for Sports Training based on Multi-Dimensional Visual Cognitive Intelligent Processing Modular Data Middleware
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: A blind separation and reconstruction method of MIMO cognitive signals under underdetermined conditions is proposed to separate and restore the intercepted overlapping signals. In this paper, some core issues involved in visual attention modeling and saliency detection algorithm research are discussed. extended research. In the model adaptation experiment, it can be found that different models have similar performance at the image level. The intelligent transformation and upgrading of stadiums is also inseparable from 5G technology. Therefore, in order to promote the practical application of mining algorithm technology in optimizing the service level of smart stadiums, this paper introduces the development status of smart stadiums in detail.

articleTitle: Application of Big Digital Media Data Compression Recognition Algorithm in Modern Art Design Training Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Application of big digital media data compression recognition algorithm in modern art design training intelligence is studied in the paper. There is an aggregation effect on the information represented by the same kind of data, and a distancing effect on the information represented by different types of data, which confirms the point of this paper, that is, the essence of classification is to “identify the differences between species and the similarities within the species”, while the data amount is large enough. Further, the big data compression algorithm and cultural image recognition algorithm are designed. MFS is a dedicated file system for virtualized clusters, while neither traditional NTFS nor ext3 are dedicated file systems for virtualized clusters. With these enhanced ideas, the performance of the model is then tested.

articleTitle: Python-Java Joint Model of Apparel Design and Color Matching Skills based on Internet Public Opinion Information Collection Cleaning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: An incremental data cleaning algorithm IACT based on clustering tree is proposed. The algorithm first partitions records by building a clustering tree. Starting from the characteristics of folk handicrafts, this paper studies the reference of current cultural and creative design to folk handicrafts, and gives Several examples of the application of cultural and creative products to the design of folk handicraft elements, such as the application of traditional clay sculpture and metal handicraft in wall calendars and desk calendars, and the application of Miao silver ornaments in modern clothing and women’s bags. Build a system development environment, Based on the Python-Java joint development environment, the main functions of the Internet public opinion information collection system are realized.

articleTitle: Intelligent Experimental Cloud Sharing Network of Clothing Design based on Digital Image Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Intelligent experimental cloud sharing network of clothing design based on digital image modeling is studied in the paper. For information resource digitization projects, the utility of OCR identification refers to the accuracy of automatic index construction. For users, the utility of OCR recognition refers to the retrievability of the recognized text. The lower the recognition accuracy of OCR, the lower the quality of index construction, and the lower the probability of being effectively retrieved by users. Inspired by this issue, the integration with the experimental cloud sharing network of clothing design based on digital image modeling is considered. Through the verification under different scenarios, the performance is then proven to be efficient.

articleTitle: A Unique Deep Intrusion Detection Approach (UDIDA) for Detecting the Complex Attacks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Intrusion Detection System (IDS) is one of the applications to detect intrusions in the network. IDS aims to detect any malicious activities that protect the computer networks from unknown persons or users called attackers. Network security is one of the significant tasks that should provide secure data transfer. Virtualization of networks becomes more complex for IoT technology. Deep Learning (DL) is most widely used by many networks to detect the complex patterns. This is very suitable approaches for detecting the malicious nodes or attacks. Software-Defined Network (SDN) is the default virtualization computer network. Attackers are developing new technology to attack the networks. Many authors are trying to develop new technologies to attack the networks. To overcome these attacks new protocols are required to prevent these attacks. In this paper, a unique deep intrusion detection approach (UDIDA) is developed to detect the attacks in SDN. Performance shows that the proposed approach is achieved more accuracy than existing approaches.

articleTitle: Deployment Strategy using DevOps Methodology: Cloud Container based Orchestration Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Software engineers spend half of their working hours going through the work of forerunners, but experts and great people of the community do emerge. Just as the working individuals have learnt the lessons about writing the code, the community has learned collective lessons to work with software development at scale. It is not easy to see these larger trends when they are busy doing small bug fixes. DevOps is one of these huge trends. It is a combination or say unification of two major traditionally separate worlds of software development and operations into one common cycle. It is not a recent act of invention, rather it is a result of years of iteration. Kubernetes, Docker Swarm, and Apache Mesos are a few of the different container orchestration frameworks that exist on the lookout. There is yet an absence of the most ideal solution for orchestration. The goal of this work is to close that gap and offer the relevant experimental results for the study.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Bayesian Network Models for Reverse Engineering Data Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: For mechanical components, "reverse engineering" refers to the process of developing a geometric CAD model based on the dimensions of an existing object. This method can be used to create new items. It would be wonderful if the cloud data could be automatically divided up into the surface patches that make up the cloud, and then an exact solid model could be produced. The use of a neural network is what is responsible for searching and detecting features in the initial scan data. The proliferation of data sources and quantities, as well as the growing acceptance of Bayesian modelling methodologies, has caused artificial intelligence researchers to focus a lot of attention on the problem of causal discovery. Investigations into causes and effects, as well as probabilistic modelling, can both profit from the application of causal Bayesian networks (CBN). In the field of mechanical engineering, "reverse engineering" refers to the process of creating a geometric CAD model by employing measurements taken from an already-existing artefact. In an ideal scenario, the cloud data would be automatically divided up into surface patches, after which a solid model would be constructed. In order to accomplish this objective, a neural network is utilised to search for and identify features contained within the initial scan data set.

articleTitle: Construction of Digital Media Learning Platform based on Maya Modeling Data Storage and Restoration
