publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: By separating young white blood cells from red blood cells, blood leukaemia can be detected with more accuracy and specificity. The only method to determine if someone has a blood problem is to take skin photos, calculate, shade, and measure them. The World Health Organization ranks leukaemia as the sixth most common cause of death globally. For a therapy to be effective and have a positive outcome, infection must be identified and detected early. In this research, it is believed that the cells that are connected to leukaemia would be able to be found and tested. Whether or not immature cells are present, as well as the degree of chronic or severe leukaemia, can be used to categories this illness. By combining morphological methods like region opening, region closing, disintegration, and expansion with histogram levelling and straight difference extending, it is possible to obtain a more even distribution of data points. As a result, the Proposed Method is more efficient than other earlier techniques.

articleTitle: The Decentralized Structure of the Digital Cultural Network Affects the Research on Education Informatization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Under the trend of "decentralization", the authoritarian environment of online ideological and political education has been broken, and the actual effect of education is difficult to achieve; the generation and dissemination of educational content is facing the crisis of "mainstream decentralization"; the identity of the subject and object of education has changed, seeking dialogue and interaction. Logical Analysis The method explores the direction of the informatization reform of higher vocational physical education classrooms mainly in three aspects: teaching mode, teaching method, and evaluation method. The ideological workers in colleges and universities are in an embarrassing situation. It is pointed out that the obstacles to the informatization of physical education classrooms in higher vocational colleges mainly include the construction of software and hardware facilities.

articleTitle: Internet Botcoder: Natural Language Processing With Automation Code Generation Using Commands
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: The fact that everything is driven by automation has shown that every part of every system can be automated, leading to the creation of techniques that can even generate code for automation. Automated code generation is a breakthrough technology that will change the way software is developed. It will enable developers to rapidly build complex and scalable applications using little or no coding. This technology will be game-changing for the industry. There are many competitive programming sites, and the online interviews paved the way for many learning programmers to compete in the competitive Sites. However, beginner programmers could not quickly develop an interest in those sites since they cannot understand the logical flow of the questions and how they are made. The mentioned problem can be overcome by a program to understand the question and produce the python code that is as closely logical to the question as possible. The proposed paper does the aforementioned method in real-time using Natural Language Processing and Machine Learning algorithms such as Neural Networks and Deep Learning, and a Graphical Interface for user-system interaction. The results are compared with other iterations and similar papers and is found to be ideal in many situations.

articleTitle: Cyber Security and Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: For a long time, security and privacy have been a source of concern for the general population. Nonetheless, rapid technological advances, the rapid growth of the internet and electronic commerce, and the development of more contemporary methods for collecting, investigating, and using private information have elevated privacy to the forefront of public and government concerns. Because of the ease with which data can be collected and stored on PC systems, the area of data mining is growing insignificance. Data mining techniques, while allowing individuals to extract hidden information, on the one hand, offer a variety of privacy risks on the other. This article provides an overview of the various data mining methods that may be utilized in cyber security to identify intrusions. This article provides an overview of data mining in the context of cyber security.

articleTitle: Diamond Shaped Micro-strip Fractal Antenna for Ultra Wideband
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: A Diamond Shaped Micro-Strip Patch Antenna (DS-MPA) is designed with fractal patterns on the patch presented in this paper. The proposed antenna is designed to meet Long term evolution network (LTE), point to multi-point and all ultra wide band applications. The chosen dielectric material for this approach is FR-4 glass-reinforced epoxy laminate material with a temperature index of 140 °C (284 °F) and dielectric constant εr of 4.4. The DS-MPA experiences the Return Loss (RL) of -23.01dB and the Voltage Standing Wave Ratio (VSWR) of 1.64 for the entire operating frequency range. The antenna is designed and simulated using HFSS and obtained good output response. It resonates at quad frequency ranges of 3.8, 5.6,8.2 GHz, which makes it suitable for 5G applications.

articleTitle: Analysis of Voltage Tracking in DC-DC Converter for an Electric Vehicle using Hybrid Adaptive Controllers
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Power distribution in an electrical vehicle is improved by using a Direct Model Reference Adaptive Control (DMRAC) technique in a buck-boost converter in this study. DMRAC is used to overcome system nonlinearity caused by variations in load demand, various driving modes (like as acceleration, stability, and regenerative brake system mode), and system disturbances. In the face of nonlinearity, DMRAC's resilience and aptitude to preserve system stability have made it popular. The DMRAC controller's behaviour is related to a PI controller in the MATLAB/Simulink application in order to evaluate its usefulness in the current system. According to the findings of the simulations, DMRAC outperforms a typical PI control method in both situations of changing load demand and disturbed systems as determined by tracking error. This response improvement in the DMRAC is shown to result in lower tracking errors and quicker rejection of transient and disturbance signals. For the first time, DMRAC has been employed in a buck–boost converter for an electric automobile, and its efficiency has never been measured earlier.

articleTitle: Environmental Monitoring System based on Intelligent Control System for Monitoring Cyclocarya Paliurus Cutting Seedlings by Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Design an environmental monitoring system based on intelligent control algorithm and Internet of Things technology. With single-chip microcomputer as the control core, it uses multiple sensors to detect the state of Cyclocarya paliurus serrata in real time, and realizes closed-loop adjustment of water temperature, water quality, light quantity and other state quantities through fuzzy control algorithm. Different cutting substrate humidity and cutting air humidity have significant effects on the rooting rate of Cyclocarya longifolia cuttings. For Cyclocarya longiflora cuttings in summer, the air humidity is controlled at about 70%, and the activity of peroxidase (POD) shows an "up-decrease-" "Rising" trend of change. But compared with the control, the change trend is obvious, and the average cycle is about 5 days earlier.

articleTitle: A Face Recognition and Sentiment Analysis Activity System using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: As well known, there has always been a strong connection between the attendance of a student being linked to their performance which indeed refers to their success ultimately, and seminars play an important role when it comes to assisting the students to meet industries’ expectations. And the traditional way of collecting the attendance before seminars is time-consuming, thus making less time for the presenter, and this can be solved using face recognition technology. Whenever there is a seminar to be held, all eligible members should register themselves in the proposed activity system with all their credentials along with their facial image. As the seminar starts, the admin captures the images of the members who are attending the seminar, and these images are used for attendance by using face recognition technology. Here, the Histogram of Oriented Gradients is used for face detection and the K- Nearest Neighbors algorithm is used for face recognition which has shown the highest accuracy. The accuracy of the algorithm in this project has shown to be 97%. The proposed system along with providing the list of all attended members also provides the attended members with a feedback slot where the members can provide feedback in the form of text. Using Natural Language Processing, Sentiment Analysis when performed on the feedback gives a clear picture of the opinions of the members, represented in the form of a histogram showing the number of members who opted for positive or negative or neutral feedback.

articleTitle: Optimization Framework of Digital Online Model for Vocal Music Training based on Computer Data Perception and Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Optimization framework of digital online model for vocal music training based on computer data perception and fusion is studied in the paper. Usually, the training in pattern recognition refers to statistical learning, that is, it requires a large number of training examples to obtain the estimated values of the parameters in the model, while the high-level voice semantic training is based on example learning. With the mentioned models, the signal fusion ideas are considered. With the development of general communication technology, audio AGC technology has also developed from analog circuits to the era of the digital signal processing. With these ideas, the digital online model for vocal music training will be then considered as the novel understanding model. Through the simulation, the framework of digital online model for vocal music training is tested and validated.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches based Fake News Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: The accuracy of information on the Internet, particularly on social media, is a growing problem. In these arenas, erroneous information, or so-called false news, cannot be identified, analyzed, or corrected using web-based data. This paper discusses where to look for "fake news" and how to use it on Facebook, one of the most popular social media sites. The Naïve Bayes Classifier is used in this method to guess whether a post will be labeled FAKE or REAL. A number of techniques discussed in the paper can be used to improve results. The findings show that machine learning approaches can be used to solve the challenge of detecting misleading information.

Author Keywords: Web Scraping are some of the terms used in this paper

articleTitle: Interpretation of Students' Cultural Confidence and Design of Online Evaluation System from the Perspective of Cluster Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: The "three-integration" type of cultural self-confidence education for college students integrates cultural self-confidence into students' moral cultivation, academic improvement and ability reserve, guides students' development direction through correct cultural values, and enriches students' cultural self-confidence awareness through rich practical activities. Four kinds of cluster scheduling structures under the background of big data are introduced respectively: centralized structure, double-layer structure, distributed structure and hybrid structure, and the reasons, applicable scenarios, advantages and disadvantages of each structure are introduced. Put forward scientific, practical and multi-dimensional suggestions and countermeasures. Provide intellectual support for the government to cultivate industrial clusters, improve regional influence, and formulate effective policies.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Skin Pigmentation Classification for Malignant Skin Lesions
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Skin cancer is a highly contagious disease that spreads quickly throughout the body of a person. Skin cancer is caused by the development of abnormal cells which is capable of invading and spreading to the other areas of the body. Therefore, to prevent the spread of cancer, early identification at a premature stage is essential. It is difficult to identify and categories the type of cancer, especially because patients have to multiple diagnoses over extended periods of time, which reduces the chances of early treatment and survival. The main goal is to distinguish malignant skin lesions from benign ones using a machine learning model. Machine learning has great potential in classifying the medical images for detecting the disease. The primary characteristics that distinguish malignant from benign tumors are colour, texture, and shape. Therefore, this research study plan to create a user-friendly application to categorize the images of skin lesions and detect cancer.

articleTitle: Intelligent Laboratory Safety Monitoring System for TiO2 Preparation and Catalytic Degradation of Industrial Wastewater based on Multi-Camera Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Analyze the characteristics of the laboratory intelligent monitoring system and establish the use of AVR Atmegal28 as the main controller; carry out research on the sensor technology, and analyze the characteristics of the sensor and laboratory intelligent monitoring system. Through a simple method is the use of titanium dioxide nanowires, reduction oxidation A novel porphyrin-sensitized TiO2/rGO photocatalyst was synthesized from graphene and porphyrin. Determine the temperature, humidity, alcohol, carbon dioxide and other sensors used in the laboratory intelligent monitoring system; take the AVR Atmegal28 as the core, expand the peripheral circuits, and connect the temperature, humidity, alcohol, carbon dioxide and other sensor modules to design the laboratory intelligent monitoring system.

articleTitle: An Artificial Intelligence Framework for Estimating the Cost and Duration of Autonomous Electric Vehicle Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Transportation, healthcare, manufacturing, office automation, and industrial automation all rely heavily on AI. Automating industrial physical systems necessitates the use of artificial / computational intelligence techniques. Adaptive Neural Networks, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning algorithms are used to identify and predict images based on the learning data. One of the most important goals is to find a low-cost replacement for the current methods. Misfire is a primary focus of the current research, which makes extensive use of the engine block's vibration signature. Fuel consumption-related characteristics such as air filter choking, gear knock, excessive engine speed, and low tyre pressure might be monitored using the same sensor data. In addition to detecting two-cylinder misfires simultaneously, the model's performance was assessed at various speeds and under load. For the vehicle management system to be created over the existing misfire detection model, all these model additions must perform consistently. Engine misfire detection with simultaneous misfire cannot be reliably detected using histogram characteristics in any format. An axial crash test simulation can be completed in 270 times less time using an artificial intelligence framework, but accuracy is sacrificed in the process. The framework's training time could be decreased from 111 hours to 37 minutes for a single sample or 3 hours for an ensemble of models, but accuracy would be sacrificed in the process.

articleTitle: Optimization of the PHP Interactive Interface of a College Online Educational Platform in a Quantum Heterogeneous Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Aiming at the Grover quantum search simulation algorithm, this paper proposes the structure of the unitary operator in the Grover algorithm, and proposes a compression method of the Oracle operator and the phase-shift unitary operator. Through theoretical analysis and experimental verification, it is proved that the compression ratio of this method is 1:8, and the online platform of colleges and universities is designed and implemented using Apache +PHP +Postg re sql. It is divided into four parts: the construction of the system application platform, the design of the system structure, the realization of the system function and the application effect. An unsupervised clustering method based on quantum theory is proposed, which is similar to the principle of quantum and potential energy change. potential energy function to determine cluster centers.

articleTitle: Data Mining of Logical Relationship Nodes of Cultural Geography Concepts and Theories based on Word Vector Matching Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: This paper proposes an automatic extraction model of concept level relationship based on word co-occurrence and word vector, which can realize the automatic extraction of concept level relationship, but the method of class label determination is relatively simple and can be further explored. Based on the research theory of cultural geography, with the support of the "Eleventh Five-Year" National Science and Technology Program and the Chongqing Scientific Research Project, starting from the relationship between village culture and physical space, the relationship between the culture and space of historical villages and towns is studied. The vector is fused with the feature word vector to obtain a new vector. The word vector and cosine similarity are integrated into the BM25 similarity calculation method, and an improved BM25 text similarity calculation method is proposed. Finally, after the new vector goes through the softmax activation layer, the result is output.

articleTitle: Biometric-based Finger-Vein Authenticating Device
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Personal data contained in consumer electronics devices are getting more and more valuable as the industry has been developing. Authentication is regarded as a leading technology in the field of security due to their various advantages, such as their ability to provide users with a secure and convenient way of accessing their information. Utilizing biometric methods involves using features like a person’s face, voice, iris, hand geometry, fingerprint pattern, or veins on the back of their hands. The features used in the approaches may not always ensure confidentiality because they are observable on the outside of the human body. One must be overly secure with those information, as it highlights physical characteristics. This paper proposes the implementation of the finger-vein authentication device explained in three stages, with the first stage as image capturing, the second stage as feature extraction, and the third stage as authentication, using the OpenCV-python tool.

articleTitle: Cloud Center Intelligent Terminal Design for the Integration of Industry and Education in Local Higher Vocational Colleges under the Background of "Internet +" Transformation and Development
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: The new model of business exchanges has broken the balance between the traditional financial model and the emerging financial model. At the beginning, due to the downward rigidity of the value system, commercial banks adhered to the rules and lacked the initiative of transformation. Through the practice of teaching activities such as double teacher training, three-dimensional textbook development and "cloud appointment + two-step" teaching method reform, this paper deeply explores the practical significance of the "three education" reform in the talent training of the integration of industry and education, in order to provide reference for the reform of talent training mode in higher vocational colleges. But at the same time, the platform also exposed some problems in the inspection process, such as unreasonable live broadcast content arrangement, difficult virtual enterprise operation, imperfect grouping function, etc., which need to be further improved in the future.

articleTitle: Intelligent Modeling System of E-commerce Consumption Behavior based on Distributed Data Integration Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: In this paper, a distributed heterogeneous data interoperability HIM model is designed by combining the main features of the two traditional data interoperability methods with the wide-area distributed environment. This model takes into account the advantages of both, and is more suitable for a wide-area distributed environment than using an integrated solution alone. This paper attempts to explore how the various factors affecting consumers' willingness to use in the original model indirectly affect the willingness to use through perceived trust. This paper collects valid data through questionnaire method, and uses SPSS19.0 statistical software to conduct empirical analysis on the data. On the basis of simple e-commerce connotation and development status, it analyzes consumer behavior in e-commerce environment, and discusses e-commerce environment. impact on consumer behavior.

articleTitle: Implementation of Lane Change Maneuver System using Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: In order to give the user a safe driving experience, research on autonomous vehicles and advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) has increased recently. To prevent vehicle collisions and to drive safely on highways, one of the trickiest moves, lane changes, must be anticipated in advance. For these kinds of applications, where different types of neural networks are utilised to anticipate lane changes in autonomous vehicles.A new structured deep neural fusion network is proposed by combining two Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) pre-trained models which are trained on BDD100K dataset. The fusion network predicts the possible lane change by calculating the distance between the ego lanes and surrounding vehicles. In comparison to the fine-tuned RseNet-50 and GoogLeNet models, the proposed fusion network performs better with accuracy of 96%.

articleTitle: Development and Analysis of Sparse Spasmodic Sampling Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: The Compressive Sensing (CS) has wide range of applications in various domains. The sampling of sparse signal, which is periodic or aperiodic in nature, is still an out of focus topic. This paper proposes novel Sparse Spasmodic Sampling (SSS) techniques for different sparse signal in original domain. The SSS techniques are proposed to overcome the drawback of the existing CS sampling techniques, which can sample any sparse signal efficiently and also find location of non-zero components in signals. First, Sparse Spasmodic Sampling model-1 (SSS-1) which samples random points and also include non-zero components is proposed. Another sampling technique, Sparse Spasmodic Sampling model-2 (SSS-2) has the same working principle as model-1 with some advancements in design. It samples equi-distance points unlike SSS-1. It is demonstrated that, using any sampling technique, the signal is able to reconstruct with a reconstruction algorithm with a smaller number of measurements. Simulation results are provided to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed sampling techniques.

articleTitle: Smart Financial Real-Time Control System Implementation based on Artificial Intelligence and Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Smart financial real-time control system implementation based on artificial intelligence and data mining is studied in the paper. Innovation and reform are important objectives for the operation and development of enterprises. With the construction, reform and innovation of intelligent financial management system, financial staff not only need to do a good job in budget management, cost control, system income data analysis, but also need to pay attention to the upgrading and maintenance of the financial management system functions. Enterprises can use the management model to adapt to the current dynamic and diversified market economic environment to ensure that smart financial management can create more economic value for the enterprise. The data mining and the AI models are integrated to construct the efficient model. It can be reflected that the designed model is intelligent and efficient.

articleTitle: Enhanced Optimized Link State Secure Routing Algorithm using RSA Crypto Key Exchange & Revocation in FANET Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: With recent developments in Flying Ad-hoc Networks (FANETs), the advancement of energy-saving technologies for numerous supportive FANETs has been feasible. Due to their higher velocity and faster modifications in route, directing in FANETs is a challenging assignment. In FANETs, traditional routing protocols send control messages (Hello messages) on a regular basis to construct and maintain routes. FANETs waste energy by maintaining an unneeded neighborhood inside the cluster by swapping excessive control message packets. To reduce these energy-consuming issues, this paper proposes a FANET routing model using Enhanced Optimized Link State Secure Routing (EOLSSR) Algorithm using RSA Crypto Key Exchange and Revocation algorithm in NS 2.35 Framework. In FANETs, the EOLSSR routing protocol is implemented and the performance metrics such as throughput, packet transfer ratio, and delay through mutable node speeds are examined. According to simulation data, the outcome of OLSR differs based on speed and agility.

articleTitle: Pulse Feature Extraction Model and Intelligent Processing of Communication Signals in Train Operation Control System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: This paper studies the train operation control system communication signal and its pulse feature extraction and intelligent processing, and proposes that the main problems of the signal system to achieve interconnection are automatic train adjustment, electronic map and physical object coding, communication protocol and safety certification, etc. Certain performances or functions sacrificed in order to achieve interconnection, especially the problem of signal system guiding the future development, need to be carefully identified and discussed. Under the interference of multipath channel characteristics, linear filtering is performed on the impulse response signal received by the train control center, and the directivity gain of the receiving end is calculated to realize the extraction of the best impulse response generated by the high-speed rail remote simplex control communication signal.

articleTitle: Design of Emergency Management System for Public Emergencies under Big Data, Intrusion Detection, and Defense
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: This article combines the overall emergency plans and emergency information management methods in major areas such as Beijing and Guangzhou, through in-depth analysis of the impact of big data on emergency intelligence analysis, sorts out the current problems in my country's emergency intelligence analysis, and designs and develops A public emergency management system based on data mining is used to analyze the role of big data in improving the democratic, scientific, intelligent, and precise aspects of platform construction, and the intrusion detection function of DDos is developed.

articleTitle: SaaS Service Architecture of Online System Platform for Engineering Project Management Teaching based on Computer Data Monitoring Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: This paper proposes a data layer architecture based on mass customization for SaaS software services, and analyzes and compares three data architecture design schemes. A dynamic data expansion model is proposed for the engineering project management teaching course and shared Schema structure. The composition structure and functional modules of the computer basic course teaching resource library are expounded, and the construction and use of the cloud computing-based computer basic course teaching resource library are analyzed with effective ways. Manage the data access of the open SaaS service platform and conduct simulation analysis. The combination of open SaaS service architecture and LRU-RSIZE algorithm can effectively solve the problem of on-demand storage and management of user data.

articleTitle: Efficient Equestrian Sports Venue Intelligent System based on Particle Filter Object Motion Detection Camera
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Efficient equestrian sports venue intelligent system based on particle filter object motion detection is designed and implemented in the paper. Traditional particle filtering often requires the participation of a large number of particles, and the particle depletion problem caused by resampling will affect the estimation accuracy. In this paper, the cluster optimization algorithm is used to improve the particle filter, which can improve the particle quality and ensure the particle diversity. When data needs to be sent, the table directly looks up the available routes, which greatly reduces the end-to-end delay. However, active routing protocols need to maintain routing information of the entire network anytime, anywhere, and nodes need to then constantly exchange control information and at this stage, the motion detection camera is further applied to construct the efficient equestrian sports venue intelligent system. Through the testing on the camera performance, the effectiveness is then proven to be efficient.

articleTitle: Application of Computer CAD Software Optimization in the Manufacture of Mechanical Reducer Considering Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Application of the computer CAD software optimization in the manufacture of the mechanical reducer considering artificial intelligence is studied in the paper. The core problem of current web-based CAD is how to use web technology to quickly and easily acquire and provide CAD remote resources, including design tools, design data, and design knowledge. To better optimize the model, the novel AI based algorithm is designed for the systematic referring. For the robustness enhancement, the neural network model is applied to the design of the comprehensive system. The manufacture of mechanical reducer considering artificial intelligence is further discussed with the comprehensive testing.

articleTitle: Guided Vehicle based with Robot Operating System for Mapping and Navigation Task
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: There are wide options of AGV’s offered to the industries, mostly the guided variation of AGV, this research provides the option of the autonomous variation, overcoming the issue of lacking in flexibility and application on the guided variation. This research designs an Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) with operating system of Robot Operating System (ROS), to integrate several sensors and systems to do mapping and navigation task. The primary sensor, Lidar was tested to obtain its accuracy, which was found to be above 96%. The sensor used proceeded onto mapping task developed by Hector, which also produced a result on map accuracy above 96% with RVIZ measurement tool to the actual dimensions of the map. After testing on the navigation of the AGV, the weight test was conducted, showing that the AGV could transport 10kg with 0.06m/s, with only 0.015m/s of speed reduction. The errors, troubleshooting methods and solutions have been discussed and the project was concluded.

articleTitle: Decision-Making Approaches for Complex Applications using Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Decision-making (DM) is the domain that can develop any type of application. Applications such as health care systems, popular product prediction on e-commerce applications, filtering of spam emails, the behavior of the user based on online purchases, etc. Machine learning (ML) algorithms are mainly used to find complex patterns from several domains. Disease prediction is one of the tasks that can work on various diseases to predict accurate diseases according to the given dataset. This task can work efficiently on text data and image data. Many image datasets such as CT scans and MRI images are used to detect the tumors from the brain scan images. Tumors are many types and all the tumors are not cancerous and some tumors are noncancerous. Deep Learning (DL) is the domain that can work better on complex datasets such as decision making. This research is mainly focused on developing the decision-making in several domains such as disease prediction, E-commerce sites, predicting autonomous vehicles (AVs), etc. The performances of several algorithms are also shown in this work.

articleTitle: Construction of Smart Sports Teaching System based on Optimization of Camera Network and Remote Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: This paper is mainly based on the physical education system optimized by the camera network and remote communication, and has made a detailed analysis of the system module functions, researched the problem of maximizing the monitoring field of view in the multi-camera network environment, and then proposed a globally optimized particle swarm algorithm to obtain the best As a result, user management, online course management, question bank maintenance management, real-time examination management, marking review management, system management, user health information collection, database design. Research by adjusting the direction of the camera. Under this new model, a new concept of camera network monitoring superiority is defined, and a nonlinear optimization equation is established based on this. In order to solve this nonlinear maximization problem, the idea of adopting global optimization method is proposed, and a specific solution with particle swarm optimization algorithm is given.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Green Building Engineering Monitoring Platform based on Agile Sensor Network Data Transmission Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Based on the existing risk management theories, this paper combines the characteristics of green building MEP projects to analyze the risks qualitatively and quantitatively. In terms of qualitative analysis, the risk factors of green building MEP projects are qualitatively analyzed by methods such as flow chart analysis, compositional analysis, and expert interviews. The algorithm first establishes a tree link model to analyze the data transmission mode and time slot requirements of wireless sensor networks; then, by using the relationship between parent and child in the tree topology, the nodes perform frame time slot allocation based on time slot requirements. For the intelligent control of household appliances in green buildings, the habit-based spatiotemporal reasoning (STCBR) model is used to observe and record the temporal and spatial partitions of user operations related to household appliances, and through the intersection and union of behavior sets.

articleTitle: LoRa WAN Communication using Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Nowadays, plants are unable to acquire nutrients and water for survival when the availability of water in the root zone falls below a threshold level. As a result, giving high-quality water at the root zone before reaching as far as possible becomes crucial. This edge limit relies on sorts of plants, soil, and climate. Because, as far as is feasible, diverse types of plants are different. The proper amount of water must be applied at the proper time to the proper area of the plant according to scientific scheduling. This necessitates ongoing soil moisture monitoring. Depending on the type of plant, its growth, the soil, and the surrounding conditions, start irrigation at the root zone according to a pre-programmed timetable. In order to schedule irrigation, the signals generated and recognized by soil moisture sensors must be processed in a microcontroller as per pre-determined program using LoRA WAN communication for long range communication. The microcontroller should also be changed to send the signal to a remote site where siphoning and water system control instruments are installed. The microprocessor also manages the output from these sensors in accordance with a pre-established programme to turn off the water system depending on the type of plant, its developmental stage, the soil, and the weather.

articleTitle: Disease Detection of Leaf Review Collection using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Nowadays, automated systems are preferred in almost all industries. In particular, automated systems are highly preferred in agriculture industry to maintain the crops healthy and for irrigation purposes. The proposed study analyses the process of disease detection in a sample leaf image by utilizing the Open CV module. The proposed model recognizes the diseased region of the provided sample leaf image and displays the disease's description. Open CV plays a key role in determining the disease name by using the image processing algorithms, which will identify the disease present in leaf images by simply using the disease name.

articleTitle: A Sequenced Approach for Customer Data Processing in Banking Applications between Various Services with Novel Decision Tree and K nearest Neighbour
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: The objective of this work is to conduct a sequenced approach for customer data processing in banking applications between various services with decision tree and k nearest neighbour. Materials and Methods: It is considered as two gatherings, for example, decision tree and k nearest neighbor algorithms where N=10 sample iterations to test the accuracy of the model for customer data processing in banking applications for various services. Result: The accuracy results of the Novel Decision Tree classifier model has potential up to (98%) and the K Nearest Neighbour model has an accuracy of (88.98%). It’s been observed that there is a statistical remarkable perfection between the Decision Tree and K Nearest Neighbour (p=0.002). Conclusion: The work results for customer data processing in banking applications between various services show that the Decision Tree algorithm has shown higher results and Significance than K Nearest Neighbour algorithm.

articleTitle: Internet Cloud Platform Assists the Design of Electronic Information System for Economic Development and Government Governance
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: This paper analyzes the government's electronic management system from the perspective of Internet platform-assisted economic development, and points out that the government must increase coordination while strengthening the network formation. The key to effective government governance lies in the synergy and co-evolution of technology and system. E-government is of great value to improve government field stress, government policy capability, government efficiency, realize open government and responsible government, and ultimately improve national competitiveness. This paper analyzes the significance of e-government construction to government governance, analyzes the problems existing in its current e-government construction by taking Shanghai as a case, and puts forward some countermeasures to promote government information governance.

articleTitle: Strain Effects in a Double Dot Quantum Dot System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Edge Computing and Applications (ICECAA)
abstract: Mechanical strain is a detrimental phenomenon in a lithographically defined gates quantum dot system. Such an effect can be observed when the system experiences a radical change in temperature from 300 K to a temperature below 1 K. Here, two types of double quantum dot architectures under different scenarios are studied: variation of silicon dioxide thickness, gate dimensions, and different gate materials using COMSOL Multiphysics. Results show that increasing the thickness of silicon dioxide and using Palladium as gate material can reduce the overall strain effects in the system.
